scope: Regression failures observed before fixes or with the corresponding production fault restored; all fault edits restored afterwards.

regressions.test: evicting a collapsed child window preserves its visible summary
regressions.after: summary retained; child window and unreferenced children released

regressions.test: removal patches release unreferenced nodes and their descendant windows
live arrivals do not splice a disconnected tail into a historical window
regressions.before: Live arrival changed the historical visible list and inserted a disconnected tail
regressions.after: list identity retained; loaded node revision still updates

regressions.test: the unloaded history boundary compares every ordering component
regressions.before: Expected 1 entity; received 2 for equal ordinals with earlier tie key
regressions.after: unloaded correction excluded by complete ordering key

regressions.test: a failed initial read retries the latest page before subscribing to revisions
regressions.after: Second request reads initial latest page

regressions.test: restarting after cancellation starts a fresh initial request
regressions.after: 2 requests; aborted request cannot strand replacement

regressions.fault: Temporarily remove timeline_active for the measured projection, then recreate before further seeding
Temporarily hydrate retained blocks in the node endpoint
regressions.failure: Root page failed while fixture CAS directory was unavailable
regressions.fixed: Both root and direct-child pages succeed; explicit body fails until fixture bodies are restored

regressions.test: prepending history preserves the mounted reading position
regressions.failure: First mounted node moved 16 px after prepending history
regressions.mechanism: Resize compensation used the viewport edge instead of the existing visible node when controls left a gap above it

regressions.test: a bounded historical window returns explicitly to an advancing live tail
regressions.before: Back to latest button absent on preceding implementation
regressions.after: Historical window excludes live tail until explicit return

commands: cd frontend && npm run e2e -- execution-nodes.spec.ts
